notes.title: 🗺️ Final Update for Rooms of Realities is now available 🌊
notes.notes:
Attention, Adventurers: it's time for the finishing touches in Rooms of Realities

Some history:

🔎Do you remember how it all started? First, we prepared a demo of Rooms of Realities, and on June 13, 2023, we launched the Early Access of the game. In that version, the entire "In the Shadows of the Pyramid" scenario was available. We were also ready for your feedback and to introduce further corrections and stories into the game.

Then, following the roadmap, we introduced further improvements to the game, as well as a new scenario, "The Forsaken Asylum" (in July), and the final set of escape rooms collected in "Nemo's Mysterious Formula" scenario (in August). This progression culminated in the release of the full version of the game on November 17, 2023, which included, among other features, Victory Rooms that allow you to pose for fancy, cool photos after completing the scenarios.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/fe16bce796fe078e026781ba43dae04da817fe3a.jpg

What now:

🔎Almost half a year has passed since the release of the full version of Rooms of Realities, and this project continues to bring us immense joy. We are pleased to announce another update aimed at enhancing the aspect of the game you've most frequently inquired about - extending the duration of the third act in the "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario.

The Final Update also enhances interactions with certain items, especially levers, and optimizes game physics, particularly during online play with friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/2eff0a10ac5ff244c8a9660c8d343a888af4cd9a.jpg

What’s next?

🔎We know that many of you enjoyed our approach to virtual Escape Rooms and that some of you would like to see more Rooms of Realities. Currently, we are not yet ready to reveal our future plans, but stay tuned to see what else we come up with in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team

notes.title: 💎 The Final Update is coming! 🌀
notes.notes:
Dear players, dear fans of Escape Rooms: we are grateful to you for supporting the Rooms of Realities project.

Last year, we had a successful Early Access launch, following which we improved the game with frequent updates and, above all, with two large scenarios: The Forsaken Asylum and Nemo's Mysterious Formula (each of them consisted of three rooms). Then version 1.0 was released, and you can fully enjoy it!

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🌀🌀🌀

It was a time of increased effort and work for us. We have drawn many conclusions and observations from it, thanks to which we are moving forward, but before we do that, we want to release a Final Update of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/d8764b5be0d96772e797038463b1570ed2447ac6.jpg

notes.title: Let's start the adventure - Rooms of Realities version 1.0 awaits!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/71bd4d047080ab4bdd7fe22f690d4a4ea6f9bff1.gif

Hello, all Adventurers and Puzzle Solvers,

After five months of intense work, effort and collecting feedback, Rooms of Realities is finally available in version 1.0! Welcome to our collection of Escape Rooms.

[previewyoutube=MfPxiJTQ9g8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check them out by playing the way you like - in single-player mode or in cooperation with up to four people. The rooms are prepared in such a way that both versions will offer just as fun experience. Check out what Rooms of Realities consists of now!

Three unique scenarios, each consisting of three chapters

🔥 In the Shadow of the Pyramids, the scenario begins by leading us to the tent where researchers study ancient artifacts, and then it guides us into the heart of the pyramid. What mysteries lie concealed within its depths, and how can we illuminate chambers that have remained shrouded in darkness for centuries?

🔥 Embark on the Forsaken Asylum scenario, where your primary instinct is to escape the eerie surroundings. Luckily, a whimsical specter is on hand to offer guidance. We've crafted a humorous homage to the classic horror films, ensuring an atmosphere that is spooky but intentionally devoid of fear and tension.

🔥 Explore the Nemo's Mysterious Formula scenario, immersing yourself in the depths of an abandoned submarine amidst extraordinary phenomena. Is there a watchful presence observing your every move? Plunge into a unique escape room adventure and unravel the secrets of a legendary sea treasure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/dde740621258bbae3f35dd229232da9d1512d852.png

Improvements in 1.00

🔶 Experience the newly renovated Lobby stage featuring enhanced graphics, updated models, designated spaces for cassettes, and new decorations.
🔶 Discover three Collectibles in each chapter, totaling 27: collectible blue orbs that become visible in the Lobby.
🔶 Enjoy an enhanced music direction for an improved auditory experience.
🔶 Victory Rooms - once you finish a whole scenario, you get access to a Victory
Room with special animations and interactions such as taking a selfie.

Core Features of the Game

🔷 Engaging puzzle-solving: Search for artifacts, immersing yourself in the role of a hero from an adventure movie.
🔷 Scenarios designed for short sessions: divided into three chapters for convenient gameplay.
🔷 VR immersion: Utilize VR technology to explore meticulously crafted environments.
🔷 Socialization: spend time with friends in a Lobby featuring trophies, and a tutorial.
🔷 Inclusivity: Rooms of Realities caters to all skill levels, emphasizing thinking and puzzle-solving over reflexes.
🔷 Ample amusing interactions: Play with virtual objects within any virtual room setting.
🔷 Flexibility: Comfortably play solo or team up with two, three, or four friends.
🔷 Comfort: Intuitive interface for seamless movement and object interaction.

A word from us

With the release of version 1.00, we are incredibly happy to be bringing our game into the world.

We aim to bring joy and lots of smiles to your experience in Rooms of Realities, especially when enjoying it with friends. Dive into the scenarios and make sure to share with us which one captured your preference the most!


~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

notes.title: Pick Your Challenge Update for Yupitergrad 2 is Live!
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/6ea62e6440b35671e6e5625f73002d8350920b0b.png
We’re back, Cosmonauts

While gathering feedback from our community, we found out that you need new challenges and that you like swinging around space stations so much - Following our recent "Comfort Zone" Update aimed at enhancing your gaming experience, we're here with some cosmic news – it's time for the "Pick Your Challenge Update."

Introducing Difficulty Levels and Modifiers

So, what’s new? Now, you have the power to tailor the challenge to your liking with our newly minted difficulty levels:

🌟 Easy: In this setting, the game is exceptionally forgiving, and your adversaries won't drain your energy as swiftly.
🌟 Normal: The current difficulty level you're familiar with.
🌟 Hard: Brace yourself for an intense cosmic ride! In this mode, the slightest misstep could mean instant peril. It's a realm exclusively for the most skilled astronauts among you!

We've also introduced something even more captivating: a total of nine options to fine-tune the game's difficulty, allowing everyone to set their Yupitergrad 2 experience to their liking.

Here are the settings you can now find in the game options menu:

💥 Enemies bullets speed - Adjust the rate of fire for enemy projectiles.
💥 Enemies damage - Customize the lethality of enemy bullets.
💥 Enemies health - Set the health levels for opponents.
💥 Enemies movement speed - Modify the agility and pace of enemy movements.
💥 Enemies shield - Define the resilience of enemy shields.
💥 Enemies shield orb spawn probability - Control the likelihood of shield orbs spawning.
💥 Minigun overheat time - Fine-tune the cooling time for your minigun.
💥 Traps damage - Determine the severity of trap effects.
💥 Closed atmospheric levels - Enhance maneuverability within enclosed atmospheric environments.

Yupitergrad 2 was originally designed with a singular difficulty level in mind, making the task of adapting more difficulty levels, and variables a cosmic puzzle in itself. Nevertheless, we've tuned various gameplay elements to ensure that everyone, from seasoned space acrobats to professional adventurers, can relish the Yupitergrad 2 experience.

🤖Now, after this update, we are excited to see even more people enjoying the exhilaration of swinging around The Lost Station.🤖

Stay with us and wait for more news about what we are preparing in the future. Supporting our games is a key priority for us - and we're already full of ideas about what else we can do.

Have fun, astronauts!

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

notes.title: Version 1.00 - New release date!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow gamers, and adventurers,

As you may recall, we recently shared our anticipation for the exit from Early Access, with plans originally set for September. However, due to some unexpected twists, we need to inform you that the release of version 1.00 of the game will be slightly delayed, with the new date set for November 17th.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 🕸️🕸️🕸️⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ 

So, what's happening during this time?

First and foremost, we improve the quality of interaction and comfort of gaming, which is crucial in VR. We're also introducing a treasure trove of collectibles and emphasizing the importance of certain events in the game, ensuring your experience is nothing short of extraordinary.

We take great care to ensure that the nine chapters we have delivered so far look as good as possible. All of this is to enable us to further develop Rooms of Realities and deliver the absolute best in gaming enjoyment (and to further develop this project).
Thank you!

[previewyoutube=ra1DJAeWOQw;full][/previewyoutube]

Rest assured, the delay is minor, and the official premiere is just around the corner. Please stay by our side as we work relentlessly to deliver a unique gaming experience.

notes.title: 💎The last update before we leave Early Access - here is the Comfort Pack
notes.notes:
Dear players and adventurers, we have good news for you!

We're nearing our departure from the Early Access phase! Throughout the past three months, our dedicated team has poured their efforts into enhancing Rooms of Realities, transforming it into a more expansive and improved gaming experience. Thanks to the support of the community and the progress of our development team, we can now announce that our next update will be an update to version 1.00. We're very excited about this and are working on polishing every aspect of the game so far.

Before we delve into what lies ahead, let's first explore the additions in the Comfort Pack Update. These features are designed to elevate your gaming comfort:

🎉 Victory Rooms - unique rooms where you can celebrate completing scenarios and take photos as souvenirs!
🎉 Free movement (without teleportation)
🎉 Free rotation
🎉 Vignette options
🎉 Minor bug fixes and improvements

🍪Naturally, the conclusion of the Early Access phase marks just the initial step on the journey ahead. You will learn about what we plan and how we will deliver it in our next announcements soon. Stay with us!

notes.title: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station - Steam version arrived 🚀
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/ddd0f667b8d30623cc0b152a855ba867b8964f8c.png

Space comrades, it's time to grab your kosmo-sticks and go on a journey through the abandoned space station 🪐

This is our most important and greatest journey - after Yupitergrad 2 was released on Pico, Meta and HTC headsets, it's finally time for the Steam version. 😉

We're thrilled that new users will have the opportunity to explore the enigmatic space base's intricate corridors and passages. This facility is overseen by a defiant artificial intelligence, which means players will need to demonstrate their skills, acquire fresh equipment, and engage in combat against rebel robots. Moreover, there will be more environmental puzzles to unravel and a greater map to navigate in order to make their escape. We have prepared something fresh for you in VR and present a real space Metroidvania in this game.

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]
👇 What awaits you in Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station? 👇

🚀 Campaign for 6-8 hours filled with jokes and comments from AISha - the artificial intelligence that accompanies us

🚀 8 unique types of traps in different variations - which must be avoided showing off efficiency and precision

🚀 3 visually distinct biomes featuring a variety of locations and numerous points of interest, making it easier to navigate and orient oneself in the field.

🚀 4 distinct pieces of equipment designed for both exploration and combat, enabling access to new areas and the ability to confront robots effectively.

And above all, it's a blast! We've designed fantastic spaces where you can swing and experiment with game mechanics, thanks to our one-of-a-kind suction cups on the ropes. It's an exceptional blend of environmental exploration, 3D platforming, shooting, and adventure gaming. Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station is a unique VR experience

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

It's important to highlight that Yupitergrad 2 on Steam is essentially version 1.1 of the game, which has already been launched on other platforms. In this release, you'll have immediate access to gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and functional fixes that were introduced in the latest update on other platforms. Our priority is to ensure that your experience is as seamless and polished as can be.

Stick around and keep an eye out for more updates! May the vastness of space, our nerdy humor, and the thrilling adventures in the corridors bring you as much joy as they do for us!

~Gamedust Team

notes.title: Avatars Update is here! Check out what's different
notes.notes:
Check out the Avatars Update together with some fixes!

Hello adventurers, we are thrilled to announce that we have exciting updates for you! 💪😊

Today we have the opportunity to thank you again for the warm welcome of Rooms of Realities. We always believed that the combination of Escape Rooms, VR technology, and the ability to play co-op and solo will be something that many people have been waiting for. Bringing a game like this into Early Access, however, means it needs to be cared for properly! And that's why we recently showed you a Roadmap that will guide us through the next updates. 🗺️

Today, we are delighted to introduce a series of fixes that will enhance your gaming experience even further. After the successful launch of the Asylum Update (we hope you enjoyed this thrilling scenario!), we have been diligently working on addressing various issues and making the game more enjoyable for all players. These fixes will ensure a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience:

🔥 Voice chat & microphone output
🔥 Avatar preview in the menu
🔥 Player avatars will be able to high five!

Stay tuned for more exciting updates as we continue to deliver outstanding VR escape rooms for you to explore. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. 📝

Soon, in August you will receive a new scenario, consisting of three fresh chapters. Nemo's Mysterious Formula!  It's going to be something really unique, but we won't reveal too much now... 🦈
